name: Salsa (Jarred)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small portions, but check labels for garlic and onion powder which are common high-FODMAP additives.
preparationTips: Choose brands that list 'garlic-infused oil' instead of garlic powder
Look for salsas with simple ingredient lists: tomatoes, peppers, vinegar, salt
Homemade salsa using scallion greens instead of onion is safer
Start with smaller portions to test tolerance
nutritionalHighlights: Vitamin C from tomatoes and peppers
